name: The Confluence Forges
narrative: With the World-Heart reignited, its radiant pulse awakens the Confluence Forges—an ancient ring of alchemical reaction chambers.

stages.title: The Alchemical Primer
stages.story: Welcome to The Alchemical Primer—the outer proving ground of the Confluence Forges where raw elemental streams merge inside crystalline reaction chambers! Guide Water and Earth into the western chamber to synthesize living Plant, and unite Fire and Water in the eastern chamber to boil into rising Wind—remembering that the newly born Plant stream must claim your single Bridge over deep water, while Wind leaps across a 1-tile Void chasm!
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: Root-Soil Synthesis
stages.story: Inside Root-Soil Synthesis, a single Confluence Chamber anchors a terraced botanical forge surrounded by molten slag veins and a 3-tile Mountain bulkhead. Unite Water and Earth inside the chamber to generate living Plant (which must cut through an overgrown Forest barrier to reach its goal), while guiding standalone Fire (lava) and Metal (heated + Tunnel) around the perimeter!
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: The Smelting Crucible
stages.story: Inside The Smelting Crucible, molten magma veins and loose mineral scree converge on an ancient blast-chamber suspended beside a deep subterranean aqueduct. Unite Fire and Earth on dry stone to forge white-hot Metal, then guide the newly smelted Metal across Heated Ground and your single Bridge + Intersection over Water, while Wind leaps a 1-tile Void chasm along the northern ridge!
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: Gale-Steam Condenser
stages.story: Perched inside the Gale-Steam Condenser, scorching Lava sluices meet cold reservoir tides to boil into pressurized Wind currents, while blinding Exposed light-shafts and pitch-dark Covered vaults guard the eastern wing. Unite Fire and Water inside the condenser chamber to generate Wind (which leaps a 1-tile Void rift to reach its goal), while Light (exposed) and Shadow (covered + Portal) thread the optical locks!
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: Permafrost Cascade
stages.story: Cascading down the Permafrost Cascade, freezing gale-winds sweep across a bottomless Void rift to collide with glacial reservoir tides inside an alchemical freeze-chamber. Unite Water and Wind to crystallize Ice (which walks across Shallows without a bridge to meet Electricity straight at the Intersection), while Electricity claims your single Bridge over deep water and Plant cuts through an overgrown Forest barrier!
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: Twin-Chamber Foundry
stages.story: Inside the Twin-Chamber Foundry, there are no standalone currents—every single source must enter one of two parallel synthesis chambers! Unite Fire and Earth to smelt Metal (which bores through a 3-tile Mountain bulkhead via your Tunnel), while uniting Water and Wind (void jump) to crystallize Ice (which crosses Shallows and intersects Metal straight at right angles)!
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: Lightning Prism
stages.story: Suspended inside the Lightning Prism, dazzling Exposed sunbeams and pitch-dark Covered vaults clash inside an optical chamber to spark raw Electricity, while molten Lava and cold reservoir tides boil into rising Wind. Unite Light and Shadow (covered + Portal) to generate Electricity (which must stay on dry stone and claim your single Bridge over water), while Fire and Water fuse into Wind to leap a 1-tile Void chasm!
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: The Living Alloy
stages.story: Inside The Living Alloy, twin mineral synthesis chambers operate side-by-side—one nurturing living roots from soil and tide, the other smelting white-hot iron from earth and flame—surrounded by blinding Exposed light-shafts and pitch-dark Covered vaults. Unite both chambers to generate Plant (forest — cannot use Portals) and Metal (heated — claims the Tunnel), while Light (exposed) crosses Plant straight at the Intersection and Shadow (covered) warps via the Portal Pair!
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: Cascade Chain-Reaction
stages.story: Behold Cascade Chain-Reaction—a multi-stage alchemical reactor where the output of one Confluence Chamber feeds directly into the next! Boil Fire and Water together in the upper chamber to synthesize Wind, vault that newborn Wind across a 1-tile Void chasm into the middle freeze-chamber with fresh Water to crystallize Ice, and unite Water and Earth in the southern chamber to grow Plant!
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: The Six-Stream Reactor
stages.story: Deep inside The Six-Stream Reactor, twin synthesis chambers temper white-hot Metal from flame and stone while sparking raw Electricity from clashing sunbeams and shadows, flanked by a rushing Water aqueduct and overgrown Plant arches. Unite both chambers and guide all seven active elements through all six one-way locks—remembering that Plant cannot use Portals (and must claim the Bridge), Metal (heated) claims the Tunnel, Shadow (covered) uses the Portal Pair, and Electricity crosses Water straight at the Intersection!
stages.budgetDescription: 1 Bridge (at (11, 6)), 1 Tunnel ((3, 5) ↔ (3, 9)), 1 Portal Pair ((2, 10) ↔ (7, 1)), 1 Intersection (placed on dry overpass (7, 8))
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: Octa-Confluence Core
stages.story: Revolving around the Octa-Confluence Core, eight elemental currents converge on twin synthesis chambers that forge living Plant and glacial Ice while surrounding streams of Fire, Metal, Water, and Shadow weave through two perpendicular overpasses. Unite all eight currents across six one-way locks and every terrain channel in Element Forge!
stages.budgetDescription: 1 Tunnel ((2, 2) ↔ (2, 6)), 1 Portal Pair ((5, 2) ↔ (10, 10)), 2 Intersections (placed at (5, 6) and (9, 9)) + 1 Bridge (at (6, 8))
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required

stages.title: The Grand Philosopher's Engine
stages.story: At the apex of The Confluence Forges spins The Grand Philosopher's Engine—a monumental three-chamber alchemical core where not a single raw element can reach its goal directly! Every starting current must fuse inside one of three interlocking reaction chambers to synthesize Wind, Plant, and Electricity, which then braid across seven one-way locks and two perpendicular overpasses to complete the Philosopher's Great Work!
stages.budgetDescription: 1 Bridge (at (11, 7)), 1 Portal Pair ((5, 2) ↔ (8, 6)), 2 Intersections (placed at (5, 10) and dry overpass (10, 7)) + 1 Tunnel (available if routing around (9, 7) wall)
stages.blueprint: User-provided November 23, 2026; unverified geometry, review required
